verdict.rationale: Netlify's own docs say Netlify Database lets developers instantly provision a managed, "production-grade" Postgres database, which covers the core of the story. Nothing in the pack documents point-in-time recovery, read replicas, or high availability. Third-party integrations such as Turso and Supabase were not credited because they are not Netlify's own capability. missing for 10: point-in-time recovery, read replicas, high-availability/failover documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of Netlify Database.

support.subject: As a developer, I can provision a fully-managed Postgres database with point-in-time recovery, replicas, and high availability
